<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\{OrderRequestBuilder, PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder, AmountWithBreakdownBuilder, AmountBreakdownBuilder, ItemBuilder, MoneyBuilder};
header('Content-Type: application/json');
$cart = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?: $_POST;
$total = 0.0; $items = [];
foreach ($cart as $sku => $qty) {
    if (!isset($PRODUCTS[$sku])) continue;
    $p = $PRODUCTS[$sku];
    $items[] = ItemBuilder::init($p['name'], MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, $p['price'])->build(), (string)$qty)->build();
    $total += $p['price'] * (int)$qty;
}
if ($total <= 0) { http_response_code(400); echo json_encode(['error' => 'empty cart']); exit; }
$r = $orders->createOrder(['body' => OrderRequestBuilder::init('CAPTURE', [
    PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder::init(AmountWithBreakdownBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, number_format($total, 2, '.', ''))
        ->breakdown(AmountBreakdownBuilder::init()->itemTotal(MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, number_format($total, 2, '.', ''))->build())->build())->build())
        ->items($items)->build()
])->build(), 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
$orderId = $r->getResult()->getId();
orders_save(['token' => $orderId, 'amount' => number_format($total, 2, '.', ''), 'status' => 'CREATED', 'created' => date('c')]);
echo json_encode(['id' => $orderId]);

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
header('Content-Type: application/json');
$in = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?: $_POST;
$orderId = $in['orderId'] ?? '';
$order = orders_get($orderId);
if (!$order) { http_response_code(404); echo json_encode(['error' => 'unknown order']); exit; }
if ($order['status'] === 'PAID') { echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]); exit; }
$capture = $orders->captureOrder(['id' => $orderId, 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
$pay = $capture->getResult()->getPurchaseUnits()[0]->getPayments()->getCaptures()[0];
$order['status'] = 'PAID';
$order['transaction_id'] = $pay->getId();
$order['payer_email'] = $capture->getResult()->getPayer()->getEmailAddress();
orders_save($order);
echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]);
changes: Added idempotency check for PAID status
